args.title: Juniper Labware: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
- Newsletter (Juniper Labware, "Cold-chain logistics in 2026") highlights this week's cold-chain logistics coverage and links to the full article.
- Article (blog.juniper.example/2026/cold-chain): temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data; most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
- Companion piece (insights.juniper.example/cold-chain/companion): pilots cut claims by a quarter.
